why_counters: EXACT_SOFTMAX_STATS / EXACT_LAYER_NORM_STATS are the package's own, and they are what proves which path ran: both all-zero is the only proof of a DEVICE-ONLY arm, because _EXACT_TRAINING defaults True. exactln_scope counts the ladder's host float64 layer norm. layer_norm_probe: `bw` backwards seen by the probe, `probed` of those measured against float64, `fp32_returned` handed back as fp32.
